newsitem.title: UK: Cairn says in Bangladesh JV talks with Shell.
newsitem.headline: Cairn says in Bangladesh JV talks with Shell.

text.p: Britain's Cairn Energy Plc said on Wednesday it was in talks with Royal Dutch Petroleum Co/Shell Transport and Trading Co Plc regarding joint ventures in Bangladesh.
The firm said it expected to give further details in April.
In January, Cairn signed a gas sales and purchase agreement for the Sangu gas field with the Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corp.
Cairn said it had now begun development drilling, with first production targeted for April 1998.
Cairn's pretax profits fell to 5.9 million stg in 1996, down from 9.5 million stg in the previous year, which included a gain of about 9.5 million stg.
The company's shares jumped 22.5p to 601 by 0815 GMT. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
